provenance.selection: Owner selected the technical sheet from rendered studies, then corrected punctuation spacing, row stacking, team-detail order, activity ranges, and the masthead mark. The masthead keeps no utility controls: theme and sign out live on the Account page, the active nav rule spans exactly its item, and the team list puts the provider jump-out with the name. Royal violet and gold remain the approved identity; gold is reserved for the mark.

narrative.overview:
Lineupkeep reads as one precise sheet: a single grotesk, square controls, a short measure, and hairlines that do the work a card used to do. Royal violet is spent in one place per view. Gold exists only in the mark. The product is calm enough to check in the morning and precise enough to trust with a lineup.

This is an Operate product: information before spectacle, familiar controls, direct labels, and honest state. Light is a warm paper; dark is a tinted violet sheet. Both are complete palettes.
keyCharacteristics: One grotesk, six text sizes, no serif
Square everywhere; hairlines instead of boxes
One 680px measure and one solid action per view
Numbers aligned with tabular figures, never prose tracking
Royal violet for interaction; gold only in the mark

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Per view, one solid violet element: the primary action. Links and live controls carry violet as text, underline, or border. Everything else is ink, soft ink, and rule. Danger is a semantic exception.

rules.name: The Gold Reserve Rule
rules.body: Gold belongs to the mark and nowhere else. It is not a status, a highlight, a badge, or a second action.

rules.name: The Rule, Not a Box Rule
rules.body: A section title owns one hairline. List rows own one hairline between them. Status and empty states use a leading rule or plain text, never a dashed or bordered card.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: The wordmark stays continuous lowercase lineupkeep at the 11px label weight and tracking, beside the square mark. Gold appears nowhere else.

dos: Do use semantic tokens and both complete themes.
Do keep controls, inputs, badges, and dialogs square.
Do keep the 680px measure and let tables exceed it only with a reason.
Do use one hairline under a section title and between list rows.
Do spend violet once per view on the primary action.
Do apply tabular numerals to comparable numbers only.
Do keep the wordmark lowercase and the mark gold.
Do preserve keyboard access, visible focus, selection, zoom, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add border radii, shadows, gradients, or a second accent.
Don't use gold outside the mark.
Don't use a serif or a second typeface.
Don't box prose, lists, notices, or empty states.
Don't add letter spacing to body text or apply tabular figures to prose.
Don't repeat a control label on every row of a list.
Don't float controls to the right of a metadata line.
Don't use colour alone for connection, automation, or risk.
